scope: Pure-software event-level association contract only. No Chisel production module, production-top binding, R1 request issue, payload transfer, sidecar transport, S2 deposit, scheduler, controller, timing, or PPA behavior.

grant_interfaces.name: PackedSourceDemand
grant_interfaces.rule: preselected opaque demand; association owner does not select page/source or alter R2 fields

grant_interfaces.name: PublicationReadAuthorization
grant_interfaces.rule: live publication authorization, never replayed publication event or authority transfer

grant_interfaces.name: DescriptorLocationGrant
grant_interfaces.rule: R5 retains descriptor/page ownership and must hold the live reference

grant_interfaces.name: S2FillLease
grant_interfaces.rule: S2 owns slot selection/generation; packed path requires explicit sidecar

exact_join: all PageRef values including generation match
publication and descriptor valid_records match within 1..64

outputs.name: R2PackedReadAllocationRequest
outputs.rule: opaque candidate fields forwarded unchanged; expected_fragment_count = valid_records * 8

outputs.name: PackedS2ReadWork
outputs.rule: only after one R2 context acknowledgement; sidecar location remains an explicit obligation

outputs.name: AssociationRelease
outputs.rule: only on later ok/fault terminal; does not imply S2 READY or attention terminal

lifetime_rules: R5 invalidation may cancel only before R2 issue
issued association must terminally release before descriptor invalidation/free
reset clears association state and gates new grants until init
association owner neither creates reset epoch nor suppresses R1 stale responses
forbidden: direct top or testbench PackedS2ReadWork producer after owner activation
descriptor inspection or inferred payload/sidecar address
R2 arbitration credit FIFO or delivery-context ownership change
R1/HBM controller CDC burst channel latency bandwidth throughput or PPA claim
